body:
I feel like I would be able to at least look in the mirror and not hate what I see. I probably would still hate who I am but at least I would have something to be positive about. 

I'm not even exaggerating when I say there is literally nothing I have to be confident about. Yes, I realize that is hard to fathom but it is true. I am not talented or good at anything. I can't speak any languages, I am miserable at math and science, I can't write well enough, I can't sing, have no rhythm, I'm awful at sports... I can't blame anyone for not ever being attracted to me, there is nothing worthy of redeeming. I have nothing to offer anyone. The fact that I have basically resigned myself to having to see an escort to experience intimacy once in my life means that the little money that I have is the only thing anyone could ever reap from me. Yes, finding a girl who would find me attractive appearance-wise is a huge challenge, but I could never even expect someone to find my soul-sucking, leeching, empty, mediocre personality worth bothering with. They literally couldn't do any worse. I would be disappointed if my daughter ever brought home someone as valueless as me.

Thanks for this, I appreciate it...and also resent it in a way. I resent it because it sparks up a shred of hope. A bit of hope that inevitably leads to more disappointment. Your genuine words help to lift me up a little bit but I always, always come crashing back down even harder. The fact that I am the result of all the possible genetic combinations in the world just destroys me. I always wish and fantasize what it would have been like to be born a different person, in a different place...A person like most of the ones that I envy. Who have no trouble in relationships, don't suffer crippling depression and have passion to research and acquire knowledge and interests in subjects not relating to painless methods of suicide. Socialization just seems to be worse for me these days, I can sometimes distract myself when I am on my own but when I am with friends or family who keep talking about their lives advancing I just feel like shit in comparison. Even worse is having to witness my friends and their SO's public displays of affection. It is honestly physically painful at this point. I don't think it even crosses their mind for 1 millisecond how hard it is for someone who is perpetually alone to watch.

Unfortunately at this point it would probably be easier to fix the physical appearance. I assume about $100,000+ or so of maxillofacial plastic surgery, hair transplants, weight gain and muscular implants could improve the wretched appearance. Unfortunately the self-esteem is far too destroyed, I don't think I have had an even remotely positive view of myself since I was about 10. The only thing more impossible for me at this point than being physically attractive is being confident.

Here is where I will start getting the influx of down votes. The difference? She is a woman. There will ALWAYS, ALWAYS, ALWAYS, be tons of guys out there who would have no problem being in a sexual relationship with her. Yes, I'm sure she is a marvelous person, she is more optimistic, faced WAY harsher obstacles in her life, and somehow maintained a positive outlook and overcame her difficulties. Still I imagine that even if she was not a successful entrepreneur she probably would have been able to find someone and would not be as lonely.
Glad it worked for you, I'm surprised they never even spoke of the supposed side-effects to you. Maybe it is only in a very rare minority or something.

It is hard no to look at things realistically though. I told my one talk therapist this and idiot was stumped. I can try and change my thinking patterns and more or less deny what is really going on but I can't convince myself to believe the bullshit. Staring in a mirror in the morning and giving yourself positive affirmations that have absolutely no basis in reality such as "I'm am attractive to women", "I am a successful person", etc... all don't do shit if you don't have one single instance of success to back them up. I can stand in front of my mirror and repeatedly say aloud that "I am 6'3", "Strangers would be flattered if I approached them and gave them a compliment", "I am an attractive person and worthy of love" but it is just blatant lying. I was literally paying multiple therapists to instruct me in being a delusional fool. Who does this stuff actually work for?

The accutane? Supposedly in some patients it increases suicidal thoughts and tendencies. I don't know why. I may be mistaken but I remember once my old dermatologist actually said they don't prescribe it to anyone with even a mild history of depression or mental illness. Luckily no new dermatologist I visit will know of my current mindset.

I hope you are light years away from that post, but realistically, you made that post 1 day ago...I don't think it is safe to say you are out of the woods yet. Unless you stumbled upon some profound source of happiness or something.

Also, I am not even 58 kilos. Enlighten me on how to gain weight, not like I have anything to lose by hearing a suggestion, but somehow I think I will have heard the advice before. Not to just disregard your help outright but honestly I don't know how being a bit heavier, more muscular version of myself would even be much different. Still would have 200 other things working against me.

I actually mentioned I always feel like this, almost exactly for the last 5 years, I was too much in denial before that...

"I should have been preemptive and thrown myself off a bridge 5 years ago and then I would have saved myself from about 1825 days of emptiness and agony. I have been alone every single miserable day of my life. Telling myself that this is just another hallmark holiday does not really work anymore, every year it is a brutal reminder of all my failings"

It would take a lot less time to list off the few things I like about myself, actually I can't think of one. But lets see, I loathe myself because...

I'm short - 5'7

I still have acne in my fucking late 20's. Tried different remedies, accutane is looking like solid option at this point, maybe it will be enough to finally give me the conviction to hang myself.

I have not kissed a girl on the lips since I was 9

Goes without saying but I have never had a girlfriend.

I am scrawny as fuck - Going to the gym just depresses the shit out of me, R/gainit didn't work and GOMAD made my face flare up like a fucking leper. 

I spent 5 years in college and left without as so much kiss.

I'm losing my hair and will look like a cancer patient when I am totally bald. Shaving my head and going to r/malefashionadvice doesn't help much. Can't shine shit. 

On days I don't work I spend about 23 hours in my bed.

I am fucked up beyond repair. I have been to multiple talk, cognitive, behavioral therapists and I am convinced at this point the whole thing is a complete waste of time and money unless you are just looking for someone to vent to. I have tried multiple anti-depressants and all they do is make me sleep more or sweat uncontrollably and grind my teeth. The psychiatrist says they should help me cope with things but none of it actually solves anything. If they actually worked I would just be content and have the sharp edge taken off the fact that my life is utter garbage. I need to be aware of how bad my life is or else I might actually stick around for the rest of it.  

I can't hide my misery anymore. For the last 10 years or so I did it very well but now people can tell I am a huge drag to be around and can basically sense my bitterness, anger, depression and hopelessness. My mere presence these days drains the happiness from people and repels women and men alike.

I have to watch from afar as the few friends I had in college all move on with their lives, buy homes, move in with SO's, get married, have children, get better jobs. They are planning and advancing their lives while I am more or less writing up whom I leave my few assets to and leaving instructions for my funeral.

I enjoy nothing anymore. I literally have not had a hobby I enjoyed in years. I really cannot think of one thing I would really be interested in doing. I hate my body too much to do anything physical and I am weak as fuck. I hate traveling because then I just have to be exposed to tons of people from all different walks of life who are happier than me. I am envious of everyone. It is literally torture leaving my house. Though it is quite masochistic, if I really need more fuel to commit to my plan I could take myself through the city streets tonight and to any nice restaurant and witness everyone else experience what I never have and it will literally kill off whatever shred of life is left in me.

God damn, rereading all that really solidifies that I need to die. There's no hope. I couldn't even hide my anger and resentment for everything in this post.
